name: gauge_block
description: Gauge block calibration. Approximate model: delta_L = Ls + D + d1 + d2 - Ls*(delta_alpha*(theta_0 + Delta) + alpha_s*delta_theta) - L_nom. Variables: Ls = reference standard length, D = measured length difference, d1 = random comparator effect, d2 = systematic comparator effect, alpha_s = thermal expansion coefficient of standard, theta_0 = mean temperature deviation from 20 degC, Delta = cyclic temperature variation, delta_alpha = difference in expansion coefficients, delta_theta = temperature difference between standard and artefact.
model_expression: delta_L = Ls + D + d1 + d2 - Ls*(delta_alpha*(theta_0 + Delta) + alpha_s*delta_theta) - L_nom

Ls.description: Calibrated length of reference standard at 20 degC

D.description: Mean measured difference in length between artefact and standard

alpha_s.description: Thermal expansion coefficient of reference standard

delta_alpha.description: Difference in thermal expansion coefficients between artefact and standard

delta_theta.description: Temperature difference between artefact and standard
